summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of GigVerdict MVP. Backend: 32/32 pytest tests passed (auth, dashboard, verdict engine, offers CRUD + decision, shifts lifecycle, deliveries, restaurant intelligence, zones CRUD + soft delete + best, analytics/time, settings, presets, goal, AI scan). Frontend: login screen renders with Google button and TAKE/MAYBE/DECLINE chips; authenticated app loads via injected gv_session_token localStorage; Home dashboard shows shift toggle, today tiles (net/hr/mile, deliveries, accept rate), goal progress with pace estimate, SCAN/ENTER buttons, best zone card, and 4 bottom tabs; Enter Offer → Verdict flow produces correct verdict label / score / WHY reasons with accept & decline buttons; Zones tab lists 4 seeded zones with Add Zone; Insights tab chip row switches to Restaurants showing pickups/wait/hourly/delay penalty; Settings tab shows presets + threshold inputs + save-settings-button; AI scan endpoint /api/offers/scan responded 200 with extracted JSON. No red screens, no critical bugs found.
action_items: OPTIONAL / low priority: review_request references testIDs 'accept-offer-button' and 'decline-offer-button' but the app uses 'verdict-accept-button' and 'verdict-decline-button'. Buttons render and function correctly; only the naming differs. Either update the request or rename testIDs for consistency.
OPTIONAL: consider adding testIDs 'tab-home', 'tab-zones', 'tab-insights', 'tab-settings' on the bottom tab bar buttons for more robust automation (currently we navigate by text).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 1113-line file; consider splitting scoring, shifts, zones, analytics into modules for maintainability (not blocking).

In compute_verdict(), when wait_used is a small non-zero float (0 < wait <= free_wait_minutes) the branch `if wait_used and wait_used > free_wait_minutes` is false so no reason is added; that is fine. Zero handling correct.
restaurant_stats.median_wait uses simple midpoint index — for even-length arrays it is not the mean of two middles; acceptable simplification.
compute_verdict divides by max(miles, 0.01) — protects div-by-zero but a payout on 0.01 mi produces implausibly high $/mile; UI stepper enforces sane values so not an issue in practice.
seed_data_creation: No seed created; used server's built-in demo account (user_demo000000001) with token gv-demo-session-token-fixed-2026. Tests created TEST_-prefixed offer/delivery/zone rows (zone soft-deleted at end).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://offer-intel-2.preview.emergentagent.com), API prefix /api. Auth via Bearer gv-demo-session-token-fixed-2026 (demo account, 10-year expiry, auto-recreated on backend startup). Frontend web preview requires localStorage.gv_session_token=<token> then reload. Comprehensive pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_gigverdict.py (32 tests, all passing, ~7s). AI scan endpoint works end-to-end with a realistic JPEG containing $/miles/minutes/restaurant text. testID naming for accept/decline in verdict screen is 'verdict-accept-button' / 'verdict-decline-button' (not accept-offer-button).
